ramka.z1: In the app, you can add this exercise to a workout or to your own template.
ramka.z2: During a workout, you log each set and see your previous result next to it.
ramka.z3: When you tick off a set, the rest timer starts.
ramka.z4: If you don't have the equipment or it's taken, the app suggests alternatives, including the same movement with different equipment.
ramka.z5: Once you choose where you train, the list shows the exercises you can do there.
ramka.z6: The exercise screen lists your recent sessions with it, and Progress shows a chart and your records.
ramka.z7: You can build a weekly plan from your templates, or generate templates and a plan from a few choices.
ramka.z8: Your history, progress, templates and backups are always available, even without the paid version.
